name: Aphelion of Ceres
description:
[term:eclipse][blue]Eclipses[/blue][/term] Slingshot and Newton's Meteor. Blocks fired by Slingshots instead fire as meteors, and your meteors apply the damage and effects their block would when fired by a Slingshot, then crumble after 3 hits.

[dark-gray]At home's comfort, guiding the flock.[/dark-gray]
